text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Black deep-V long-sleeve blouse and flowing black wide-leg tailored trousers, black pointed heels. No detachable scarf or corset belt.. Add ONLY these accessories: long thin black neck scarf; wide structured black corset waist belt; black structured trapezoid tote; black rectangular oversized sunglasses; pair of silver sculptural earrings; small dark pendant on fine silver necklace. Closed inventory: use each listed item exactly once and add no other objects.

Add ONLY these accessories: long thin black neck scarf; wide structured black corset waist belt; black structured trapezoid tote; black rectangular oversized sunglasses; pair of silver sculptural earrings; small dark pendant on fine silver necklace.
